name: Runner Extras - Table Connection Live OOS
brief: Issue #2725: Database.RegisterTableConnection used to throw an untyped InvalidOperationException from a Roslyn shim for source-compiled AL while precompiled callers got a silent Cecil no-op. The skeleton session now carries BC's own TableConnectionManager, so BC's unmodified bodies run. This suite pins the one runner-specific contract left: a CRM connection registered with anything other than the '@@test@@' test string would open a live Dataverse connection and is refused as RunnerOutOfScopeException (docs/scope.md#table-connections), while the '@@test@@' connection is NOT refused and lands on BC's in-process CrmTestDataProvider.
description: The plain-BC half of this behaviour — RegisterTableConnection + HasTableConnection true, SetDefault/GetDefault round-trip, Unregister clearing the default, Insert into a TableType = CRM table assigning a Guid primary key, BC's own 'not registered' error without a connection — is BC behaviour and lives upstream in the al-language corpus (session/TestDatabaseTableConnectionCrm.al), where a real service tier adjudicates it. Only the out-of-scope refusal and its scoping stay here.
